user_name.description: The display name for the user account managing the calendar data.

data_file.description: The absolute or relative path to the .pcal data file. If null, defaults to ~/.pcal/default.pcal.

first_day_of_week.description: The integer representing the first day of the week (0 for Sunday, 1 for Monday).

show_bbt_graph.description: Boolean flag to enable or disable the Basal Body Temperature graph visualization by default.

enable_notifications.description: Boolean flag to enable system notifications for fertility predictions.
